- Fed rate currently 3.5%–3.75%, on hold since December

- Inflation drivers: Trump tariffs, Iran war oil prices, AI investment boom
- Fed Chair Kevin Warsh (not Powell) speaks Friday at Jackson Hole
- Internal Fed division on rate hikes
- Rising US Treasury yields already in play
